Name: Minimal Vanilla House Edit
Author: octilery
Description:
I made this because the yellow wood/red roof combo was hard on my eyes.

Colors and textures of certain elements are altered to be cohesive to one another.
- stone surrounding the foundation matches the chimney and all upgrades
- shutters are less busy and colors match the rest of the house
- siding gets upgraded with the second expansion
- third expansion's random pillar matches the fencing
- third expansion's door embellishments line up with the window

Possible future updates
- clean up the second and third expansion's roofs
- shutter edits
- second expansion door symmetry
- third expansion's porch boards and steps will revert to the second expansion's
